summary: Confirmed a distinct rejected teacher-reply draft loss in the current cycle21 source. The prior topic-draft recovery is present, but reply submission has no corresponding controller draft or render projection. Primary meaningful case: a valid 79-character reply at the 500-reply fixture cap returns reply_limit_reached; reply count stays 500 and the visible thread-detail reply form rerenders empty. No account-service receipts or network activity; no repo files changed.

findings.rejectedWhitespaceReply: reply_required; updateDraft(content) returned false; replyDraft absent; emitted reply textarea blank; reply count remained 2.
findings.explicitCorrection: Succeeded on explicit second dispatch; reply count 2 to 3; one corrected body stored; composer blank after success.
findings.replyCap: At 500 aggregate replies (2 seeds + 498 fixture setup replies), valid 79-character body returned reply_limit_reached; count remained 500; separate reply form on the visible /posts/topic-official-bug-forum detail route remained present but blank.
findings.authority: community.reply is the validation/storage authority: role must be teacher; target thread must be accessible; trimmed body must be nonempty and <=10000 chars; aggregate reply limit is 500. Public controller supplies synthetic authorId demo-teacher. HH account/session service is not invoked by forum replies.
findings.lifecycle: Current reply composer holds no draft state. app.mjs submits FormData then controller dispatch synchronously rerenders onChange, replacing DOM. Community role exit hides teacher actions; logout sets community role anonymous and navigates to login; forum reset resets fixture data; app reset sets anonymous, resets forum and navigates home. Topic-only topicDraft clearing does not cover reply content.
findings.storage: Probe used createCommunity({storage:null}); no forum key is written and no draft persistence is claimed. Production/backend/browser behavior was not tested.

smallestAcceptanceCases: Teacher submits whitespace-only reply: reply_required, zero new replies, exact bounded body/category equivalent remains projected in the same thread composer for correction.
Teacher corrects retained reply explicitly: exactly one reply is created, then that thread's reply draft clears; no auto-retry or account-service receipt.
Teacher reply over aggregate cap: valid bounded body remains available for correction; no reply is created.
Reply draft is not exposed to anonymous/moderator; clear it on teacher-role exit, logout, forum reset, app reset, and leaving/changing thread; unrelated thread state must not inherit it.
